description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。


> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样。
description.en:
A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client. Ensure this value is unique across different requests. ClientToken only supports ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify a value, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken** identifier. The **RequestId** for each API request might differ.

description.zh:
DNS授权规则描述。

长度为2~256个字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，但不能为`http://`或`https://`。
description.en:
The description of the DNS authorization rule.

The length is 2 to 256 characters. It must start with an uppercase or lowercase English letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The ID of the DNS authorization rule.

description.zh:
DNS授权规则名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the DNS authorization rule.

The length is 2 to 128 English or Chinese characters. It must start with an uppercase or lowercase English letter or a Chinese character. It can contain numbers, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
目标DNS授权规则IP地址。

> 当**ServiceType**参数取值为**DNSRedirect**时，该参数必选。
description.en:
The destination IP address of the DNS authorization rule.

> If the **ServiceType** parameter is set to **DNSRedirect**, this parameter is required.

description.zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
- **true**：发送检查请求，不会修改DNS授权规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行修改。
description.en:
Checks whether this request would succeed. Valid values:

- **true**: Send a check request. This does not modify the DNS authorization rule. The check items include required parameters, request format, and business restrictions. If the check fails, the system returns an error. If the check passes, the system returns the `DryRunOperation` error code.

- **false** (default value): Send a normal request. If the check passes, the system returns an HTTP 2xx status code and directly modifies the rule.
The ID of the cloud connector instance group.

description.zh:
云连接器实例组所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[ListRegions](~~313836~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID where the cloud connector instance group resides.

Call the [ListRegions](~~313836~~) interface to get the region ID.

description.zh:
DNS授权规则的目标类型。取值：

- **Normal**：表示目标类型为DNS普通类型。

- **DNSRedirect**：表示目标类型为DNS重定向类型。
description.en:
The target type of the DNS authorization rule. Valid values:

- **Normal**: The target type is a normal DNS type.

- **DNSRedirect**: The target type is a DNS redirection type.

description.zh:
源DNS授权规则IP地址。包括但不限于以下取值：

**100.100.2.136**，**100.100.2.137**，**100.100.2.138**，**114.114.114.114**，**8.8.8.8**，**8.8.4.4**，**223.5.5.5**，**223.6.6.6**，**221.5.88.88**，**116.116.116.116**，**221.228.15.26**，**61.139.2.69**，**218.6.200.139**，**119.29.29.29**，**218.2.2.2**，**208.67.220.220**，**208.67.222.222**，**218.4.4.4**。

<props="china">除以上默认的DNS授权规则的IP，如有其他DNS授权规则的IP诉求，请[提交工单](https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today)，并在工单中附上需要申请的DNS授权规则的IP。
</props>

<props="intl">除以上默认的DNS授权规则的IP，如有其他DNS授权规则的IP诉求，请[提交工单](https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.11182188.console-base-top.dworkorder.18ae4882n3v6ZW#/ticket/createIndex)，并在工单中附上需要申请的DNS授权规则的IP。</props>
description.en:
The source IP address of the DNS authorization rule. This includes, but is not limited to, the following values:

**100.100.2.136**, **100.100.2.137**, **100.100.2.138**, **114.114.114.114**, **8.8.8.8**, **8.8.4.4**, **223.5.5.5**, **223.6.6.6**, **221.5.88.88**, **116.116.116.116**, **221.228.15.26**, **61.139.2.69**, **218.6.200.139**, **119.29.29.29**, **218.2.2.2**, **208.67.220.220**, **208.67.222.222**, **218.4.4.4**.

<props="china">

If you need other DNS authorization rule IP addresses beyond these defaults, [submit a ticket](https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today). Include the DNS authorization rule IP addresses you want to request in the ticket.

</props>
